高麗笛是日本傳統宮廷音樂雅樂中使用的一種橫吹竹笛，屬氣鳴樂器。笛身通常以竹製成，: The komabue is a side-blown bamboo flute used in gagaku, the traditional Japanese court music; it is an aerophone. The body is usually bamboo, with six fingerholes, an overall length of 36 cm, an inner diameter of 9 cm and a range from F♯5 to E7, and it is shorter than the ryūteki. It is played side-blown and is used mainly in gagaku settings such as komagaku, kokufu kabu and azuma asobi.

A beginner can first practise holding the flute steadily and covering the holes so that they close completely, then blow a basic note with a steady airstream. Because the flute is short, the embouchure and the position of the holes have to work together; avoid blowing too hard or leaving a hole not fully covered.
